claims.text: The Qwen Research License defines non-commercial as research or evaluation and grants use, reproduction, distribution, modification and derivative rights only for non-commercial purposes.
Commercial use requires a separate commercial licence from Qwen.
Redistribution requires a copy of the agreement, notices on modified files and the specified attribution notice.
A distributed or available AI model created, trained, fine-tuned or improved using the materials must display the licence's specified Qwen acknowledgement.
The agreement contains an intellectual-property litigation termination clause, warranty exclusions, an indemnity obligation, Chinese governing law and exclusive jurisdiction in Hangzhou.
